{{Quote|Transmitter traffic from Loronar is spiking. We're going to be looking at a whole constellation of battlemoons if the Empire can pump these out.|Colonel Haxen Delto, to General Airen Cracken discussing Torpedo Spheres|<ref name="Rebel Files">''[[Star Wars: The Rebel Files]]''</ref>}}
'''Loronar''' was an astronomical object<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> located in the [[Loronar system]]<ref name="Appendix" /> of [[the galaxy]]'s [[Colonies]] region that was situated along the [[Corellian Run]].<ref name="TFABG" /> During the [[Early rebellion against the Galactic Empire|early rebellion]] against the [[Galactic Empire]], the [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service|intelligence branch]] of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic|Rebel Alliance]] witnessed a spike in [[transmitter]] traffic from Loronar. Alliance Intelligence was able to deduce that a constellation of [[Torpedo Sphere]]s were active. Paired with intelligence on equipment suppliers, [[Colonel]] [[Haxen Delto]] expressed to [[Chief of Intelligence|Chief of Rebel Intelligence]] [[General]] [[Airen Cracken]] that they should be worried.<ref name="Rebel Files" />
